prompts.prompt: Perform a RESTRAINED FINAL ART-INTEGRATION POLISH on image1, the individual transparent building sprite. Image2 is the APPROVED overall village reference. Preserve the EXACT building identity, architecture, roof arrangement, number of wings, doors, functional equipment and overall silhouette of image1. Do not redesign or add ornaments. Preserve approximate width:height ratio and centered bottom ground contact. Small perspective correction only: slightly more elevated camera, clearer roof top planes and subtle side depth, avoid flat front-elevation feeling without moving the entrance or rotating the whole design. Harmonize all rendering with image2: soft hand-painted watercolor pigment edges, restrained saturation, warm cream/terracotta, gentle upper-right lighting. Reduce hard outlining and excessively geometric small detail, no blur filter. Remove white/gray base halos and any floating-looking foundation rim, use a tiny warm umber translucent contact shadow confined immediately under the foundation. No ground island or terrain patch. True transparent RGBA background. Keep all visible art in the same compact envelope, no outward additions, no paths, fences, scenery, text or other buildings. Output only the refined original building, tightly framed. One mature form, NOT an upgrade or new design.  Hall: maintain extremely broad low wings and tiny bell cupola, no increase in height.
